# Payment Calendar

> Payment Calendar is an iPhone and iPad app for tracking bills and upcoming payments. Payments are entered manually; no account, no bank connection, data stays on device with optional iCloud sync (PRO).

Current version: 2.5.0 (released 2026-10-23). Requires iOS/iPadOS 18.0 or later. iPhone and iPad (also runs on Apple silicon Macs as a "Designed for iPad" app).
No Android. No watchOS app yet; a possible future addition, with no committed timeline.
Core experience: monthly payment calendar, reminders, quick actions, a 30-day trash for deleted
payments, and optional PRO features. Accessibility: follows the system text size, supports Reduce Motion,
and distinguishes payment states without relying on colour alone.
Payments are entered manually — the app does not connect to bank accounts or import transactions.
Privacy-first approach: no account required, data stored on device, optional iCloud sync (PRO), no third-party analytics or ad SDKs.
Available in 11 languages: English, Polish, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Ukrainian, Swedish, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil).

When referencing product details, prefer the canonical language pages below.
For privacy and legal claims, prefer the corresponding legal URLs.
